data.content:
{
 "component": "date-picker",
 "file": "kit/date-picker.js",
 "about": "Three forms that ask for a date. The kit is the same in each: the page passes the bounds, the days that cannot be chosen and the presets, and gets ISO dates back.",
 "locales": ["en-GB", "en-US", "de-DE", "fr-CA", "ja-JP", "ar-EG"],
 "cases": [
  {
   "id": "stay",
   "label": "Hotel stay",
   "context": "Harbour View Hotel, Lisbon: a guest picks check-in and check-out. Nights already full (24, 25 and 31 December) are struck through; the presets are the hotel's two packages.",
   "mode": "range",
   "field": ["Check-in", "Check-out"],
   "locale": "en-GB",
   "value": { "start": "2026-12-18", "end": "2026-12-21" },
   "min": "2026-11-23",
   "max": "2027-11-22",
   "closed": ["2026-12-24", "2026-12-25", "2026-12-31"],
   "presets": [
    { "label": "Advent weekend, 11 to 13 Dec", "value": { "start": "2026-12-11", "end": "2026-12-13" } },
    { "label": "New Year, 1 to 4 Jan", "value": { "start": "2027-01-01", "end": "2027-01-04" } }
   ],
   "note": "The page checks that the stay does not run across a full night before it books."
  },
  {
   "id": "due",
   "label": "Invoice due date",
   "context": "Invoice INV-2026-0418 to Okafor Joinery Ltd, issued 20 November 2026. Payment falls on a business day: no weekends, no bank holidays (25 December, 1 January).",
   "mode": "single",
   "field": "Due date",
   "locale": "en-US",
   "value": "2026-12-15",
   "min": "2026-11-20",
   "closedWeekdays": [0, 6],
   "closed": ["2026-12-25", "2027-01-01"],
   "note": "Typed 12/25/2026 is refused with a reason; the value stays 2026-12-15."
  },
  {
   "id": "birth",
   "label": "Date of birth",
   "context": "An age-checked sign-up: the person must be 18 or older on 22 November 2026. No value yet, so the calendar opens on the latest allowed day; Shift and Page Up go back a year at a time.",
   "mode": "single",
   "field": "Geburtsdatum",
   "locale": "de-DE",
   "value": null,
   "min": "1900-01-01",
   "max": "2008-11-22",
   "note": "Typing 3.5.1987 or 1987-05-03 gives the same value."
  }
 ]
}

entry.name: Date picker
entry.summary: A date field with a calendar popover for one day or a range: ISO values in and out, keys as the WAI-ARIA date picker dialog, min, max and disabled days, presets, typed ISO or local dates, Intl names.
